name: strawberry-jam
description: strawberry jam is my personal fork of the project jam created and developed by sxip.
author: glvckoma

scripts.dev: npx tailwindcss -i src/styles/app.css -o assets/styles/style.css --minify && npm run pack && npx cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.test: npx tailwindcss -i src/styles/app.css -o assets/styles/style.css --minify && npm run pack && npx cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .
scripts.pack: npm install --prefix assets/client && npx asar pack assets/client assets/app-client.asar --unpack *.node
scripts.build: npx tailwindcss -i src/styles/app.css -o assets/styles/style.css --minify && npm run pack && node scripts/generate-installer-script.js && npx electron-builder build -w
scripts.publish: npx tailwindcss -i src/styles/app.css -o assets/styles/style.css --minify && npm run pack && node scripts/generate-installer-script.js && npx electron-builder build -w -p always
